excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫德萨努协和国的高等文明占据了！
excerpt.en: The [From.GetName] have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the Dessanu Consonance!
